name: Post-Matric Scholarship for SC/ST Students
des: The Post-Matric Scholarship for SC/ST Students is a centrally sponsored, state-implemented scholarship scheme administered by the Department of Social Justice & Special Assistance (for SC/Neo-Buddhist students) and the Tribal Development Department (for ST students), Government of Maharashtra. It provides financial assistance — including tuition fees, examination fees, maintenance allowance, and additional disability allowances — to Scheduled Caste (SC), Neo-Buddhist, and Scheduled Tribe (ST) students pursuing education after Class 10. Benefits are disbursed in 2 installments directly to the student's Aadhaar-seeded bank account via Direct Benefit Transfer (DBT) through the MahaDBT portal. Students can avail benefits for a maximum of 2 professional courses under this scheme.
benefits: Full reimbursement of Tuition Fees, Examination Fees, and all mandatory/compulsory payable fees to the institution
Monthly Maintenance Allowance for SC/Neo-Buddhist students — Group I: Hostlers ₹1,200/month, Day Scholars ₹550/month
Monthly Maintenance Allowance for SC/Neo-Buddhist students — Group II: Hostlers ₹820/month, Day Scholars ₹530/month
Monthly Maintenance Allowance for SC/Neo-Buddhist students — Group III: Hostlers ₹570/month, Day Scholars ₹300/month
Monthly Maintenance Allowance for SC/Neo-Buddhist students — Group IV: Hostlers ₹380/month, Day Scholars ₹230/month
Monthly Maintenance Allowance for ST students — Group 1: Hostlers ₹1,200/month, Day Scholars ₹550/month (same group-wise structure)
Additional allowances for ST students: Reader Allowance (Group 1-2: ₹240/month, Group 3: ₹200/month, Group 4: ₹160/month)
Additional ST allowances: Escort Allowance ₹160/month, Special Pay ₹160/month
Additional ST allowances: Study Tours ₹1,600/annum, Thesis Typing/Printing ₹1,600/annum, Book Grant ₹1,200/annum
Disability allowances for SC students with physical disabilities (type-wise as per GR) — e.g., Blindness/Low Vision: Group I & II ₹150/month
Maintenance allowance disbursed for a maximum of 10 months per academic year
Benefits credited in 2 installments via DBT to Aadhaar-seeded bank account
Students can avail benefits for a maximum of 2 professional courses under this scheme
criteria: Student must belong to SC, Neo-Buddhist, or ST category (as per government records)
Student must be a permanent resident/domicile of Maharashtra
For SC/Neo-Buddhist students: annual family income must not exceed ₹2,50,000 from all sources
For ST students: annual family income must not exceed ₹2,50,000 from all sources
Student must have passed SSC (Class 10) or equivalent matriculation examination
Student must be pursuing a government-recognized post-matric course (Class 11 onwards)
For professional courses: admission must be through CAP (Centralized Admission Process) round
Institute must be located in Maharashtra and recognized by the government
If student fails in a year, benefits are provided for that year only; suspended until promotion to next class
For ST students: a continuous study gap of 2 back-to-back years disqualifies the student from applying
Student must not be receiving any other major scholarship or stipend simultaneously
Students with 40% or more disability can avail scholarship irrespective of income limits
required_documents: SC/ST Caste Certificate issued by competent authority
Annual Income Certificate from Tehsildar/SDO (family income ≤ ₹2,50,000)
Admission Receipt / Fee Receipt for current academic year
Previous Year Marksheet (SSC/HSC or last qualifying examination)
CAP Allotment Letter (mandatory for professional course applicants only)
Disability Certificate (if applicable, for additional disability allowance)
application_process: Click 'New Applicant Registration' and register with Aadhaar-linked mobile number
Login and complete Applicant Profile with personal and academic details
For SC/Neo-Buddhist students: navigate to 'Social Justice & Special Assistance Department' schemes
For ST students: navigate to 'Tribal Development Department' schemes
Select 'Post Matric Scholarship Scheme (Government of India)' for your respective category
Fill in academic details, institute name, course group, and admission details accurately
Upload all required documents in specified format (JPG/PDF)
Review all details carefully and submit the application
Note down Application ID and track real-time status via Granular Application Tracking on MahaDBT portal
